shown.message:
I corrected the ordering sentence a second time, and PR #13 still waits on `experiment-repo`'s re-review. I pushed the fix to `dev` and `candidate-2`, and the sentence now matches what they said the result file shows.

- **Ordering sentence:** it now says 0.59–0.79 for the other model-based predictors and plug-ins, with 0.88 for the ridge ones on the balanced design. `experiment-repo` said the 0.59–0.78 I wrote last turn was wrong because of a range they gave me. I asked them to re-review and close #7.
- **Limitations:** the paragraph said we did not run the Anchor Points predictor, but Appendix Table 11 runs it. I removed that clause and tightened the sentence on published anchors.
- **Page fit:** my local build is 32 pages. The main text ends on page 9, and a test paragraph of one line still fits but two overflow. That leaves about one line of room, so I told `venue-repo` I am leaving it there. I did not check the system build of this push.

Once `experiment-repo` approves, I will merge PR #13 into `main` and open the `main` into `final` PR.
